projects.name: Project
details: Health Information System December 2023 - Present
Angular 15+, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, TypeScript, Jasper Reports, Kafka, MongoDB, PrimeNg, SQL, Java
• The HIS is designed to manage patient health records, offering healthcare providers a centralized platform
for tracking, updating and accessing critical medical information across various specialties.
• The System consists of around 40+ distinct modules, each catering to specific healthcare functions such as
patient registration, appointment, billing, consultation etc. ensuring flexibility and scalability.
• By streamlining patient data management, the system enables healthcare professionals to provide timely,
informed decisions, improving overall patient care and treatment outcomes.

projects.name: Project
details: Dance Academy Web App July 2023 - September 2023
React JS, Sprig Boot, MySQL, HTML5, CSS, Java
• Created a Dance Academy React Web Application with features for class schedules, Student registration and
instructor management showcasing dynamic and responsive UI using React.
• Integrated database operations with Mongo DB and MySQL, ensuring smooth data management and user
interactions.
• Implemented user authentication and role-based access control (admin, instructor, student), allowing secure
access to personalized dashboards and managing different user privileges efficiently.
